subject: pri-info
title: (R)PRI.INFO.-----SG.------PROJ.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 339 (R(AS)CM(I)-23). PRI-INFO (principle information) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; SG (source initiation) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) are the partners in the title. From SG: PROJ-DY and TH-CONT (thrust continuance). AFI (affinity insight) is on a dotted line from SG. From PROJ-DY: CULT-INFO (culture information), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From CULT-INFO: TR (transformation). From TR: C-CONT (composite continuance) and SOC-RT (social reality).
